# Phoenicia Capital Holdings

> Privately held group that owns TeachWise, Petrovate, Cedar Capital Bank, and Cedar Payroll. Founder and CEO: Ali A Hammoud.

Phoenicia Capital Holdings builds and operates companies in education recruitment, energy technology, digital banking, and UK payroll. Offices are in Dubai, Beirut, and London.
